# DATA ROOM INDEX AND EXTRACTS (synthetic, target: Target Fleet Services Co. LLC)

## 1. Commercial register extract (Ministry of Commerce)
Target Fleet Services Co. — limited liability company — CR 1010999999 — capital SAR 500,000 — partners: Mr. A (Saudi national) 51%; Overseas Fleet GmbH (Germany) 49% — manager: Mr. B (German national) — activity: IT consulting; fleet management services — status: active.

## 2. Articles of association (extract)
Art. 9: A partner wishing to transfer shares to a third party must first offer them to the other partners at the same price; the other partners have 30 days to accept. Art. 14: Decisions of the partners require a majority of 75% of the capital, except amendments to these articles, which require unanimity.

## 3. MISA investment registration certificate
Issued 2024-08-01 to Overseas Fleet GmbH for "IT consulting". Valid one year, renewed 2025-08-01. Activity on the CR also lists "fleet management services", which does not appear on the certificate.

## 4. GOSI establishment statement (2026-08)
Registered workers: 42. Outstanding contributions: 3 months unpaid, SAR 210,000 including late-payment charges.

## 5. Qiwa establishment page (2026-08)
Nitaqat band: Low Green. Saudi employees: 9 of 42. Two Saudi employees' contracts are not documented on Qiwa.

## 6. Management agreement (2023)
Between Target and Overseas Fleet GmbH: Overseas Fleet GmbH "shall manage all operations of the Company, control its bank accounts and receive 95% of net profits as a management fee"; Mr. A "shall have no role in management and receives a fixed annual amount of SAR 60,000".

## 7. Distribution agreement (2022)
Target is the exclusive distributor in the Kingdom of telematics hardware made by EuroTrack S.A. (France). The agreement has not been registered with the Ministry of Commerce.

## 8. Customer contracts (three, each above SAR 800,000 per year)
Each contains: "Customer may terminate this Agreement on written notice if there is a change in the control of Supplier." Each is governed by Saudi law. One contains an assignment clause allowing assignment to affiliates without consent; the other two are silent on assignment.

## 9. Financial statements FY2025 (extract)
Accumulated losses: SAR 280,000 against capital of SAR 500,000.
